title: test_transitions' demo-gate teeth write nothing into the live tickets store
intention: test_transitions' three demo-gate teeth read a scratch tickets store patched at ticket_file._TICKETS, and write nothing into the live one.
why: Measured 2026-11-16 in a write audit of 149b's 74 verdict proofs: 273 write sites are scratch and one is live. test_transitions.py:1654-1738 writes three fixture tickets and a validations/ directory into the real commons tickets store and unlinks them after. That is a record-store write on every run. Under e56a68e651c2's parallel verdict it races test_v2_migration.py:171 and :251, which glob the store and then read each file, so a reader can list a fixture and find it gone.
traces_to: Law 8 and RULE 1: a ticket's proofs measure only their own component, so a proof writes into no record of truth.
how: Add a _scratch_tickets() context manager that saves ticket_file._TICKETS, points it at a TemporaryDirectory's tickets/, enters inspect_wire.launch(ticket_store=tickets) so the scratch CodeMother answering crossing_demo reads the same store, and restores _TICKETS in a finally. Run each demo tooth's fixture writes inside it. crossing_demo derives the validation path from the ticket file's directory (inspector.py:2865), so the scratch store holds both. A red-first tooth wraps Path.write_text, write_bytes, mkdir, touch, unlink and rmdir in an ExitStack while the three teeth run, and reds on any recorded path under the live store or any fixture name standing there.

clauses.claim: while the three demo teeth run, no write_text, write_bytes, mkdir, touch, unlink or rmdir is recorded under the live ticket_file._TICKETS, no fixture name stands there after, and _TICKETS is restored; red on origin/main, which records the fixture writes
a demo: true ticket with no DEMO validation raises DemoGateRed from _require_demo, against the scratch store
a ticket with no demo flag returns a None note from _require_demo, against the scratch store
a demo: true ticket with a green DEMO validation beside it returns a note naming Akien's approval, against the scratch store

decisions.text: D1: _scratch_tickets() patches ticket_file._TICKETS, the one patch point (D10), and names the same store to the scratch CodeMother with inspect_wire.launch(ticket_store=...), restoring _TICKETS on exit including a raise; the three demo teeth stage their fixtures inside it.
D2: the red-first tooth records every file-writing Path call while the three teeth run, so a write unlinked afterwards is still seen; PROVES gains this ticket's four clauses.

measured.saw: 273 of 274 write sites in 149b's 74 verdict proofs are scratch; test_transitions.py:1654-1738 writes test-demo-ticket.json, test-no-demo-ticket.json, test-demo-sealed-ticket.json and validations/test-demo-sealed-ticket.json into the live ticket_file._TICKETS and unlinks them in a finally
measured.how: an AST classifier over the 74 proofs' write calls, following each target to its binding, then each unresolved site read by hand

measured.saw: crossing_demo is not run in the proof's process: _require_demo asks it of a scratch CodeMother over the bus (transitions.py:310 ask_inspector, via inspect_wire), and her ticket_file._TICKETS is derived from her __file__, which is the live commons. So patching _TICKETS in the proof alone moves nothing she reads; the scratch store must also be named to her with inspect_wire.launch(ticket_store=...), as test_entry_gate_jurisdiction.py:80-83 does. Measured 2026-11-16 in a scratch dry run: with the patch alone, the refusing tooth reds (she found no ticket); with both, all four pass.
measured.how: the built proof run from a scratch copy against a fake live store, both directions: the four teeth pass built, and the recorder reds on the origin/main teeth with three fixture write_text and unlink calls while the store is left empty
